description: Edits the developer's account profile; only the fields sent change. A new name also becomes the owner name on all their apps; a new studioSlug changes the studio page's address. Emails: neblla_developer_email; password and AI keys: web dashboard only. More: neblla_get_llms tools/developer_profile_update

about.description: Up to 1500 characters; null clears it.

links.description: Up to 6 [{ label?, url }], replacing the list; [] clears it.

name.description: Public author name, up to 50 characters (a studio or company name).

studioSlug.description: Short name in play.neblla.com/studio/<studioSlug>: 3-30 of a-z, 0-9, -; must be free.

web.description: Official site, https; null clears it.
